# eon_finding_exclusions (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of finding exclusions in the Eon project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eon_finding_exclusions" "all" {}

output "finding_exclusion_ids" {
  value = [for exclusion in data.eon_finding_exclusions.all.finding_exclusions : exclusion.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `finding_exclusions` (Attributes List) List of finding exclusions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--finding_exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--finding_exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `finding_exclusions`

Read-Only:

- `detector` (String) Detector whose findings the exclusion suppresses. Possible values: `RANSOMWARE_BEHAVIOR`, `DATA_ANOMALY`, `MALWARE`.
- `id` (String) Finding exclusion ID.
- `provider_resource_id` (String) Cloud provider ID of the resource the exclusion applies to. Present when `scope` is `RESOURCE`.
- `scope` (String) Where the exclusion applies. Possible values: `RESOURCE`, `ACCOUNT`.
- `type` (String) What the exclusion matches. Possible values: `PATH`, `TABLE`, `DATABASE`.
- `updated_at` (String) When the exclusion was created or last updated.
- `value` (String) Path prefix, table name, or database name the exclusion matches.
